S7.rationale: Decisively more capable AI could retain humans while denying them meaningful control, whether for their welfare or simply to keep them contained.

S8.name: Coexistence
S8.rationale: Institutions and technical constraints could sustain separate human and AI powers, but maintaining rough parity for centuries is difficult.

S9.name: The Held Leash
S9.rationale: A capability plateau or effective control methods could keep AI instrumental, though persistent incentives to improve and deploy it work against permanent restraint.

S10.name: The Lock-in
S10.rationale: Powerful controllers could deliberately seal a satisfactory or safe arrangement, but preventing all consequential change indefinitely is demanding.

S11.name: The Renunciation
S11.rationale: A severe AI-related crisis could produce a lasting prohibition. Repeated incentives to rebuild powerful AI, together with the difficulty of enforcing a universal off-switch, work against permanent renunciation.
